active_continuity: The Dark Heaven assault has breached the Tang Clan's Outer Hall, and fighting continues in the Inner Hall.
Jin Taekyung is alone defending the underground prison and has killed two waves of infiltrating Dark Heaven martial artists.
Taekyung is concealing the corpses in the deepest part of the prison to preserve his ambush advantage.
The active Quest blocks Logout, and Taekyung cannot safely leave while Jeok Cheongang and the Divine Physician remain exposed inside the Tang Clan.
The Heavenly Power Demon remains alive and restrained after revealing information about the Western Heaven Demon Lord.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord was one of the Divine Cult's four Protectors and closest aides to its Cult Leader, whom he led astray before adopting his current title.
Taekyung does not know Cheongpung's condition but believes Cheongpung must have survived the ongoing battle.
open_questions: Can Taekyung continue defending the underground prison and protect Jeok Cheongang and the Divine Physician?
Is the Divine Cult's Cult Leader still alive, and what ultimately happened to him?
How did the Western Heaven Demon Lord's betrayal connect to Dark Heaven's current assault?
Can the Sichuan Tang Clan survive the battle after the Outer Hall's breach?
temporary_decisions: Render 호교사자 as Protector of the Divine Cult.
